description:
Wheat genes co-expressed with a wheat gene across the expVIP RNA-seq compendium (about 970 samples in 317
tissue x age x stress x variety groups, RefSeq v1.1), for guessing function and shortlisting candidates (e.g. genes
under a QTL that behave like a known gene). Pearson r of log2(TPM + 1) across the groups; top partners with
their RefSeq v2.1 ID, location and description; the gene's own homoeologues are flagged (they usually rank
first). gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (converted to v1.1). top: up to 50; min_r: drop weaker partners.
Co-expression is association, not interaction or regulation; say so, and that askWheat computed it.
name: wheat_coexpressed_genes
